title: Public S3 Bucket Leaking Customer PII and SSNs
description: Bucket 'customer-pii-production' contains unencrypted customer social security numbers and is publicly readable.
evidence_detail: Matched SSN regex pattern with 100% confidence across 42,000 objects with PublicRead ACL.

title: Unused AdministratorAccess Role with Star Permissions
description: IAM role 'legacy-bastion-role' has AdministratorAccess attached and has not been used in 180 days.
evidence_detail: Action: * on Resource: * granted to inactive assume-role policy.

title: Toxic Attack Path to Production RDS Crown Jewel
description: Internet-exposed EC2 instance possesses IAM role to read RDS customer database snapshots.
evidence_detail: Multi-hop path: Internet -> igw-01 -> ec2-bastion -> iam:PassRole -> rds-prod-db.
remediation_action: Revoke IAM PassRole privilege from bastion profile and enforce network security group boundary.

title: Active C2 DNS Tunneling Beacon Detected
description: High-frequency base64 encoded TXT record requests to adversary-controlled dynamic DNS infrastructure.
evidence_detail: 45,000 queries in 5 minutes to *.c2beacon.evil-domain.com with entropy > 4.8.
remediation_action: Isolate host i-0123456789abcdef0 using security group quarantine and initiate forensic snapshot.

title: SQL Injection in Public Authentication Route
description: Unescaped username parameter allows authentication bypass via tautology injection.
evidence_detail: Payload '' OR '1'='1' bypassed query filter returning admin user token.
remediation_action: Enforce parameterized SQL prepared statements in database query layer.

title: Public Model Weights Storage Bucket
description: Fine-tuned LLM weights stored in public S3 bucket without KMS encryption or IAM authorization.
evidence_detail: PublicRead grant allows downloading model checkpoint weights (pytorch_model.bin).
remediation_action: Apply restrictive bucket policy requiring authenticated company identity.

title: Dependency Confusion Vulnerability on Internal Scoped Package
description: Internal package 'auth-token-signer' was detected on public npm registry.
evidence_detail: Internal package exists on public npm registry without namespace reservation.
remediation_action: Claim and reserve package name on public npm registry or enforce private proxy.

title: Privileged Container with Host Path Mount
description: Container pod executes with securityContext.privileged=true and mounts /var/run/docker.sock.
evidence_detail: privileged=true and hostPath=/var/run/docker.sock allows container breakout.
remediation_action: Remove privileged flag and restrict host socket access.

title: Hardcoded AWS Access Key in Terraform Source
description: Terraform configuration file contains plain-text AWS secret key.
evidence_detail: Pattern match AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16} found in source commit.
remediation_action: Revoke AWS access key in IAM console and migrate to AWS Secrets Manager.

title: Security Group Inbound Port 22 Open to Internet
description: Security group contains rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on port 22.
remediation_action: Restrict SSH inbound CIDR to corporate VPN gateway.

title: RDS Snapshot Not Encrypted with KMS
description: Database snapshot backup lacks KMS customer-managed key encryption.
remediation_action: Copy snapshot and enable KMS encryption with alias/prod-rds-key.

title: Build Provenance References Mutable Tag
description: Artifact provenance uses branch name 'main' rather than immutable commit SHA.
evidence_detail: source_commit_sha='main' does not meet SLSA Level 3 pinning requirement.
remediation_action: Update build workflow to pin checkout to full 40-character commit SHA.
